_comment: Hard-block registry read by the PreToolUse hook on BOTH Claude Code and Codex. Machine-specific: ships empty so sharing never blocks a friend's tools. /capture adds entries. Each entry: tool (canonical tool name as the platform reports it), reason, use_instead, platform ('claude' | 'codex' | 'both', default 'both'), added (YYYY-MM-DD). The hook is registered with a CATCH-ALL matcher (Claude '*' / Codex '.*') and gates by this registry, so adding an entry here is ENOUGH — no matcher edit needed. Takes effect after the next Claude Code / Codex restart.
